parameters.toolDescription: Retrieve internship role evidence from the persistent PostgreSQL knowledge base. Supply input as a concise search including company and selected role ID, and role_id as the exact selected catalog ID, such as NVIDIA-01. The metadata filter restricts results to that role. Returned document metadata identifies source_title, role_id, company and source_version. If no matching documents are returned, report role_not_found; never substitute a different role. This tool retrieves evidence only and cannot save applications.

metadataValues.name: role_id
metadataValues.value: ={{ $fromAI('role_id', 'Exact selected catalog role ID, for example NVIDIA-01. Do not infer a different role.', 'string') }}

parameters.description: Calculate exact calendar days from today in Asia/Kolkata until an internship deadline. Call with input containing one real ISO date, for example 2026-12-15. Negative days mean expired. Does not infer closing hours or modify data.

Count words in the EXACT final plain-text cover letter, including greeting and signature, and return its SHA-256 digest. Call with the complete letter in input, not a summary or a previous draft. Uses whitespace_v1 and a 250-word limit. Recount after any edits. Does not save or approve the letter.
parameters.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"input":{"type":"string","description":"The exact plain-text letter with actual line breaks.","maxLength":20000}},"required":["input"],"additionalProperties":false}

parameters.content:
## Setup required
1. MCP Server: select an HTTP Header Auth credential (X-Internship-MCP-Key).
2. search_internship_roles: select the PostgreSQL knowledge credential.
3. Gemini Embeddings: select your Google Gemini API credential.
4. Prepare pgvector/table with the accompanying SQL, then load role documents using the upcoming Knowledge Loader.

Publish to obtain the Production MCP URL. Importing or publishing alone does not populate the database. Search needs matching embeddings and indexed metadata.

No credentials, sample resumes or in-memory knowledge are included.

## MCP contract
search_internship_roles: input + role_id
days_until: input = YYYY-MM-DD
word_count: input = exact final letter

Only share the production endpoint and authentication credential with trusted server-side clients. Select only required tools in each client.

Execution payload saving is disabled to avoid retaining letter text in n8n logs. Test with synthetic text; enable detailed saved traces only intentionally during development.
